classdef.name: PageReference
classdef.shortdesc: The page reference for an index topic.

property.name: sourceText
property.shortdesc: The hyperlinked text or insertion point.

property.name: id
property.shortdesc: The unique ID of the PageReference.

property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the PageReference (a Topic).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the PageReference within its containing object.

property.name: pageReferenceLimit
property.shortdesc: The paragraph style or number of paragraphs or pages that defines the last page in a page range. Note: Valid only when page reference type specifies the next use of a paragraph style or a number of paragraphs or pages. . Can return: ParagraphStyle or Long Integer.

property.name: pageNumberStyleOverride
property.shortdesc: The character style applied to page numbers.

property.name: label
property.shortdesc: A property that can be set to any string.

property.name: name
property.shortdesc: The name of the PageReference; this is an alias to the PageReference's label property.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: insertLabel
method.shortdesc: Sets the label to the value associated with the specified key.

method.name: extractLabel
method.shortdesc: Gets the label value associated with the specified key.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the PageReference.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
